summary: Test-writing run for issue #39 (tests + LID docs only). Committed: (1) the solver parity corpus fixture with 13 hand-verified cases (doctest, exact match, measured-zero-vs-missing, exclusions, zero-weight channels, 2- and 3-way ties, weight-flip pair, fractional weights, all-excluded, target-missing edge) plus SolverParityCorpusTests enforcing scorer best-match parity and CompositionSolver fast-path agreement; (2) PaletteAPIContractTests characterizing the /api/v1 wire contract and error taxonomy as the generated-client migration safety net; (3) OpenAPIClientIntegrationTests, red until the manifest declares swift-openapi-generator/-runtime and the OpenAPI document covers both consumed endpoints; (4) docs for corpus consumption/refresh, migration plan, and the criterion map. Every corpus case's expected selection/score/exclusions/ties was independently recomputed against the documented algorithm before commit (all 13 PASS). Environment limitation: Linux container with no Swift toolchain; the package targets macOS + Core Graphics, so swift test cannot execute here - tests must be run with `cd ColorComposerCore && swift test` on macOS/Xcode 16 in the implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.reason: Migration-preservation tests committed (wire contract, request shapes, bearer handling, error taxonomy that gates offline fallback; cache namespacing already covered by the permanent ProfileColorCacheTests suite). Cannot execute: no Swift toolchain in this container.

acceptance_criteria.reason: Corpus fixture + parity tests committed (scorer best-match harness: selection, score, exclusions, tie sets, earliest-wins; plus CompositionSolver fast-path cross-check and a corpus-shape guard). Every case's expected values were independently recomputed against the documented algorithm before commit (13/13 pass), but swift test cannot run in this Linux container; must be executed on macOS in the implementation run.
